user.title: AutoShuttersControl for HA
user.description: One setup for all covers. Choose the global sensors now; everything else is in the options. Add covers and profiles afterwards with the buttons of the integration.

data_description.workday_sensor: Binary sensor of the Workday integration. Without a sensor Monday to Friday are workdays.
data_description.workday_tomorrow_sensor: Workday integration with a days offset of 1. Without a sensor Monday to Friday are workdays.
data_description.calendar: Used when the times come from the calendar.
data_description.brightness_sensor: Illuminance in lx, for the modes Brightness and the privacy by brightness.
data_description.rain_sensor: Binary sensor (on = rain) or rain amount (mm, mm/h).
data_description.wind_sensor: Sensor in km/h (or the unit of your thresholds).
data_description.indoor_temperature_sensor: For shading, usually set per cover or profile.
data_description.weather_entity: Weather condition and daily forecast for shading.
data_description.forecast_sensor: Today's maximum temperature; used instead of the forecast of the weather entity.

abort.single_instance_allowed: AutoShuttersControl is already set up. Add covers and profiles to the existing entry.

init.title: Global settings
init.description: These values apply to all covers unless a profile or the cover sets its own value.

schedule.title: Schedule
schedule.description: Morning and evening drive. Sun: the sun event plus offset, kept between the earliest and the latest time. Time: at the earliest time.

data.horizon_up: Own sun elevation in the morning
data.horizon_down: Own sun elevation in the evening

data_description.up_mode: Time: at the earliest opening time. Sun: at the sun event.
data_description.down_mode: Time: at the earliest closing time. Sun: at the sun event.
data_description.offset_up: Minutes added to the sun event; negative is earlier.
data_description.offset_down: Minutes added to the sun event; negative is earlier.
data_description.down_tomorrow_workday: The evening uses the times of tomorrow, e.g. the day-off times on Friday evening.
data_description.time_source: Calendar: an event whose title contains the text below sets the earliest (start) and latest (end) time of that day. Days without an event use the times.

sensors.title: Sensors
sensors.description: Sensors used by all covers. A profile or a cover can use its own sensor instead.

data_description.workday_sensor: Binary sensor of the Workday integration. Without a sensor Monday to Friday are workdays.
data_description.workday_tomorrow_sensor: Workday integration with a days offset of 1. Without a sensor Monday to Friday are workdays.
data_description.calendar: Used when the times come from the calendar.
data_description.brightness_sensor: Illuminance in lx, for the modes Brightness and the privacy by brightness.
data_description.rain_sensor: Binary sensor (on = rain) or rain amount (mm, mm/h).
data_description.wind_sensor: Sensor in km/h (or the unit of your thresholds).
data_description.indoor_temperature_sensor: For shading, usually set per cover or profile.
data_description.weather_entity: Weather condition and daily forecast for shading.
data_description.forecast_sensor: Today's maximum temperature; used instead of the forecast of the weather entity.

data_description.pos_sleep: While residents sleep. Empty = closed position.
data_description.pos_comfort: Used for a fully open window while the switch Comfort is on.
data_description.pos_shading_alt: Used while the entity for the alternative position (page Shading) is on.
data_description.pos_privacy_up: Empty: same as the evening privacy position.
data_description.pos_frost: Soft frost protection: closing stops here. Empty = off.
data_description.pos_rain_window: Rain with an open window. With the lock-out protection at most the ventilation position.
data_description.tolerance: A cover within this distance of a position counts as being there.

drive.title: Drive behaviour
drive.description: Delays and rules for every drive.

data_description.delay_fixed: Seconds to wait before a scheduled drive.
data_description.delay_random: Up to this many seconds are added at random, so that not all motors start together.
data_description.drive_time: Time for a full run. Position reports during this time after our own command count as our drive.
data_description.open_never_down: No morning drive if the cover is already further open.
data_description.close_never_up: No evening drive if the cover is already further closed.
data_description.recovery: After a restart or when the cover is available again, the target is calculated again and driven to if a drive was missed.
data_description.logbook: An entry at the cover for every drive and every drive deliberately not done, with the reason.

override.title: Manual override
override.description: A drive that did not come from AutoShuttersControl (button, app, wall switch) starts a manual override.

data.manual_counts_open: Opening by hand counts as morning drive
data.manual_counts_close: Closing by hand counts as evening drive

data_description.override_blocks: These drives wait until the override ends.
data_description.override_return: When the override ends the cover drives to its current target.
data_description.manual_counts_open: Opened by hand between the earliest opening and the scheduled time: no further morning drive that day.
data_description.manual_counts_close: Closed by hand between the earliest closing and the scheduled time: no further evening drive that day.

reset.title: Reset fields
reset.description: The chosen fields go back to the default value.

light.title: Brightness and sun elevation
light.description: For the modes Brightness and Sun elevation: the cover opens as soon as it is bright enough between the earliest and the latest opening time, at the latest time at the latest. Closing works the same way.

data.light_logic: Brightness and sun elevation combined with

data_description.light_logic: Only for the mode "Brightness and sun elevation".
data_description.brightness_duration: Against short changes, e.g. clouds or headlights.
data_description.elevation_source: Fixed: the values below. Sensor: the value of the sensor. Sensor + offset: sensor value plus the values below.
data_description.elevation_sensor: Sensor, number or input_number with a sun elevation in degrees.

window.title: Window contacts
window.description: Ventilation when the window is tilted, comfort when it is open, and lock-out protection for doors.

data_description.window_value_open: For a window sensor with three states.
data_description.window_value_tilted: For a window sensor with three states.
data_description.ventilate_enabled: Drive to the ventilation position when the window is tilted or open.
data_description.ventilate_only_up: Opening the window never lowers the cover.
data_description.window_open_delay: Seconds the contact must stay open (against fluttering).
data_description.window_close_delay: Seconds the contact must stay closed.
data_description.window_close_return: Only after a ventilation drive or a closing that waited for the door.
data_description.lockout: Soft or hard: the cover does not close while the door is open and closes when the door is closed. Hard also waits with rain and wind and can lock the actuator (page Special functions).

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.description: Before the evening drive the cover goes to the privacy position, before the morning drive to the morning privacy position.

data_description.privacy_brightness: Empty = off. Starts the evening privacy after the earliest closing time as soon as it is this dark.

residents.title: Residents and self defense
residents.description: The house status comes from persons, device trackers, zones, bed or sleep sensors, alarm panels or helpers. Several sources: asleep > going to sleep > awake > at home > absent > gone.

data.sleep_close: Close when the residents go to sleep
data.wake_open: Open when the residents wake up

data_description.residents_house: Person: home = at home, otherwise absent. Zone: number of persons. Binary sensor / input boolean: on = asleep, off = awake. Alarm panel: away = gone, night = asleep, home = at home. Sensors and selects with the state names asleep, gotosleep, awoken, home, absent, gone.
data_description.residents_gone_hours: A person who is away longer counts as gone. 0 = off.
data_description.presence_up: Drive in the morning only when someone is at home, or only when nobody is.
data_description.presence_down: Drive in the evening only when someone is at home, or only when nobody is.
data_description.wake_open: When it is day, the cover goes to its target (open, shading).
data_description.sleep_allow_open: Open in the morning even if the residents still sleep.
data_description.self_defense_mode: Closes covers with an open or tilted window when nobody is at home. Also needs the switch Self defense of the central device.
data_description.self_defense_all: Also covers without an open window.

shading.title: Shading
shading.description: Shading starts when all conditions of the list Must and one of the list Or are met, and ends with hysteresis. Conditions without a sensor are ignored.

data.shading_end_sun_leaves: End at once when the sun leaves the area

data_description.shading_mode: Off by default. Always, or only when someone / nobody is at home.
data_description.shading_azimuth_start: Compass degrees: 90 east, 180 south, 270 west. The window faces the range between these values.
data_description.shading_brightness_sensor: Empty = the brightness sensor of the page Sensors.
data_description.shading_forecast_min: Empty = not used. From the forecast sensor or the daily forecast of the weather entity.
data_description.shading_temp_hysteresis: Shading ends only below the threshold minus this value.
data_description.shading_any: A condition in both lists counts as Must.
data_description.shading_end_open: Off: the cover stays at the shading position until the evening.
data_description.shading_only_down: A cover that is lower than the shading position stays where it is.
data_description.heat_protection_temp: Shades from this outdoor temperature on, also without sun, and keeps it until the evening. Empty = off.
data_description.shading_alt_entity: While on, the alternative shading position is used.

tilt.title: Slats
tilt.description: For venetian blinds: slat position per drive. Empty = the slats are not changed. Only for covers that support a tilt position.

data.tilt_close_first: Close the slats before a new setting

data_description.tilt_shading_steps: Up to 4 steps sun elevation:slats, e.g. 20:70, 35:50, 50:30. Below the first step the slats when shading are used.
data_description.tilt_mode: Position then slats after the wait, when the cover stands still, or slats first (e.g. Z-Wave).
data_description.tilt_timeout: After this time the slats are set even if no standstill was reported.

protection.title: Rain, wind and frost
protection.description: Sensors are on the page Sensors. Rain and wind protection are off by default; switch them on in the profile of the covers that need them (awnings, venetian blinds).

data.rain_window: Water protection with an open window
data.rain_window_states: Water protection when the window is
data.rain_window_over_lockout: Water protection closes completely despite the lock-out

data_description.rain_threshold: Rain amount above this value. A binary sensor counts on as rain.
data_description.rain_hysteresis: Rain ends only at or below the threshold minus this value.
data_description.rain_delay_end: Minutes without rain before the cover goes back.
data_description.rain_window: Closes the cover to the water protection position when it rains and the window is open. Fires the event autoshutterscontrol_rain_window.
data_description.rain_window_threshold: Empty = the same as Rain from.
data_description.rain_window_over_lockout: Off: with the lock-out protection the cover goes at most to the ventilation position.
data_description.wind_hysteresis: Wind ends only below the threshold minus this value.
data_description.wind_delay_end: Minutes with calm wind before the cover goes back.
data_description.frost_hysteresis: Frost ends only above the threshold plus this value.

special.title: Special functions
special.description: Force functions, pause, party, advent, trigger and wiggle. Fields with entities are set per cover.

data.force_return: Go back after a force function
data.party: Takes part in the party mode
data.advent: Takes part in the advent mode

data_description.force_return: When the force entity turns off, the cover goes to its target.
data_description.party: While the switch Party of the central device is on, the cover does not move automatically (except protections).
data_description.advent: While the switch Advent of the central device is on, the evening closing waits from the 1st Sunday of Advent until the end date, until the button Release deferred drives is pressed.
data_description.wiggle_value: Percent for the function check (button Wiggle).
data_description.wiggle_wait: Seconds before the cover goes back.

extra.title: Extra conditions and actions
extra.description: Conditions and actions like in automations. Variables: cover (entity id) and trigger.

data.action_override_end: Action at the end of the override

data_description.condition_all: Automatic drives only when it is true. Protections, force and service calls without rules are not affected.
data_description.action_rain_window: Once per rain with an open window, e.g. a notification.

fhem_import.title: Import from FHEM
fhem_import.description: Paste your fhem.cfg (or the lines of the AutoShuttersControl device and of the shutters with the attribute ASC 1 or 2). Only define and attr lines are read; nothing is sent anywhere.

fhem_covers.title: Shutters
fhem_covers.description: {count} FHEM shutters found. Choose the Home Assistant cover for each; suggestions come from similar names. Empty = not imported.

fhem_entities.title: Devices
fhem_entities.description: FHEM devices used by AutoShuttersControl (sensors, window contacts, residents). Choose the Home Assistant entity for each. Empty = setting not imported.

fhem_done.title: Import

error.fhem_nothing_found: No AutoShuttersControl device and no shutter with the attribute ASC found.
